import MeasureTheory.Measure
import ProbabilityTheory.Law
import Analysis.NormedSpace.Basic
import Topology.SecondCountable
import Topology.Borel

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {X : Ω → E}
  [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E]
  (hX : ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw X P) : MeasureTheory.Integrable X P :=
by
  have h_integrable : MeasureTheory.Integrable X P :=
    by
      apply ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw.integral_eq
      exact hX
  exact h_integrable
